description: Project scaffold and shared foundation that every later feature builds on: TypeScript strict toolchain, env/config, the db layer (pool + query + withTransaction), money bigint helpers + canonical_json, the hand-rolled ordered .sql migration runner, Dockerfile/compose, .env.example, and GitHub Actions CI skeleton. Depends on nothing. All later FEATs depend on this. Leaves the repo building (tsc clean) with unit tests runnable with no DB.
steps: Create package.json: engines.node>=22, type=module. deps: express@^4, pg, node-cron, zod, uuid; devDeps: typescript@^5, vitest, @types/node, @types/express, @types/pg, @types/node-cron, cross-env, tsx (for running .ts scripts/entrypoints). scripts: build='tsc', typecheck='tsc --noEmit', test='vitest run', test:unit='vitest run test/unit', migrate='tsx scripts/migrate.ts', seed='tsx scripts/seed.ts', start:api='node dist/server.js', start:worker='node dist/worker.js', lint='tsc --noEmit' (no eslint config required; a clean tsc --noEmit is the lint bar per the task's 'clean lint').

Create tsconfig.json: strict=true, noUncheckedIndexedAccess=true, exactOptionalPropertyTypes=true, module=NodeNext, moduleResolution=NodeNext, target=ES2022, outDir=dist, rootDir='.', include src/scripts/test, esModuleInterop, skipLibCheck. Create vitest.config.ts (globals, node environment, test match test/**/*.test.ts, no coverage gate).

Create src/config/env.ts: parse+validate process.env with zod -> typed config object. Fields: DATABASE_URL (required for db paths), PORT (default 3000), LLM_PROVIDER (enum mock|ollama, default mock), OLLAMA_URL (default http://localhost:11434), OLLAMA_MODEL (default llama3.1:8b), RECON_CRON (default nightly cron), ADMIN_TOKEN (optional), IDEMPOTENCY_CLEANUP_HOURS (default 24). Export a loader that throws a clear error on invalid env.

Create src/db/pool.ts: a pg Pool from DATABASE_URL. Configure pg type parsing so BIGINT (OID 20) is returned as string (pg default) — do NOT globally parse to Number. Create src/db/query.ts: query(text, params) helper and withTransaction(fn) that acquires a client, BEGIN, runs fn(client), COMMIT, and ROLLBACK on throw, always releasing the client. withTransaction must support an isolation level option (READ COMMITTED default; REPEATABLE READ for recon) by issuing SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL after BEGIN.

Create src/money/money.ts: parseAmount(input: number|string): bigint that accepts a JSON number (must be a safe non-negative integer) or a numeric string, rejects non-integer/negative/overflow beyond 2^63-1 by throwing a typed error (mapped to 400 INVALID_AMOUNT later), and serializeAmount(b: bigint): string. Add canonicalJson(body): string implementing design §11.1 (parse-then-normalize; money fields to canonical bigint decimal string; object keys sorted lexicographically by UTF-8 code unit; no insignificant whitespace; NFC string normalization; booleans/null lowercase) and sha256Hex(s): string (node:crypto) returning lowercase 64-char hex.

Create src/db/migrateRunner.ts: ensure schema_migrations(version TEXT PK, applied_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()) exists; read migrations/*.sql sorted lexicographically; for each not-yet-applied version: BEGIN, run the file SQL, INSERT the version row, COMMIT; a failure rolls that file back and aborts with non-zero exit. Idempotent on re-run. Export runMigrations(pool) callable from scripts/migrate.ts and from server/worker startup.
Create scripts/migrate.ts: CLI that builds the pool from env and calls runMigrations, exits non-zero on failure. (scripts/seed.ts is created in FEAT-002 once the schema exists.)
Create .env.example documenting DATABASE_URL, PORT, LLM_PROVIDER=mock, OLLAMA_URL, OLLAMA_MODEL, RECON_CRON, ADMIN_TOKEN, IDEMPOTENCY_CLEANUP_HOURS.

Create Dockerfile (multi-stage: build stage runs npm ci + tsc to dist/; runtime stage copies dist + node_modules + migrations, one image). Create docker-compose.yml with three services per design §16: db (postgres:15, pg_isready healthcheck, named volume, POSTGRES_* env), api (built image, depends_on db healthy, runs migrations then node dist/server.js, exposes PORT), worker (same image, depends_on db healthy, runs node dist/worker.js). Shared env with LLM_PROVIDER=mock.

Create .github/workflows/ci.yml: on push/PR; a postgres:15 service with health options; steps: checkout, setup-node (LTS), npm ci, run migrations via npm run migrate against the service DATABASE_URL, then npx vitest run with LLM_PROVIDER=mock. Fail build on any failing test.

Create a tiny placeholder unit test test/unit/money.test.ts asserting parseAmount/serializeAmount/canonicalJson/sha256Hex behavior so vitest has something to run and the money helpers are covered (expand in later FEATs).
acceptance_criteria: npx tsc --noEmit completes with zero errors.
npm run build emits dist/ with no errors.
npx vitest run test/unit passes (money/canonicalJson/sha256 unit tests green) with no database required.
migrations/ directory and scripts/migrate.ts exist; running migrate without a DB fails loudly (non-zero) rather than silently.
verification: Run: npx tsc --noEmit  -> expect zero errors.
Run: npm run build  -> expect dist/ produced, exit 0.
Run: npx vitest run test/unit  -> expect all unit tests pass.
findings:
COMPLETED. Verified locally (Node v26.8.1, npm 11.19.0): `tsc --noEmit` exit 0 (no errors); `tsc` build exit 0, emits dist/; `vitest run test/unit` 15/15 passed (no DB); migrate with unset DATABASE_URL fails loudly (exit 1, message 'Invalid environment configuration: - DATABASE_URL: Required'). Docker/Postgres NOT available here, not needed for FEAT-001.

APIs later FEATs depend on:
- npm scripts: build=tsc, typecheck=tsc --noEmit, lint=tsc --noEmit, test=vitest run, test:unit=vitest run test/unit, migrate=tsx scripts/migrate.ts, seed=tsx scripts/seed.ts, start:api=node dist/server.js, start:worker=node dist/worker.js.
- Env (src/config/env.ts): `loadConfig(env=process.env): AppConfig` (named export, zod-validated, throws aggregated error). AppConfig fields: DATABASE_URL (required string), PORT (number, default 3000), LLM_PROVIDER ('mock'|'ollama', default 'mock'), OLLAMA_URL (default http://localhost:11434), OLLAMA_MODEL (default llama3.1:8b), RECON_CRON (default '0 2 * * *'), ADMIN_TOKEN (optional string), IDEMPOTENCY_CLEANUP_HOURS (number, default 24).
- DB pool (src/db/pool.ts): `createPool(databaseUrl: string): pg.Pool`. Sets pg INT8 (BIGINT OID 20) type parser to return STRING (never Number) — parse to bigint in the mapping layer.
- DB query (src/db/query.ts): `query<T>(pool, text, params=[]): Promise<QueryResult<T>>`; `withTransaction<T>(pool, fn: (client: PoolClient) => Promise<T>, options?: { isolationLevel?: 'READ COMMITTED'|'REPEATABLE READ' }): Promise<T>` — BEGIN + SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL (default READ COMMITTED; pass 'REPEATABLE READ' for reconciliation), COMMIT, ROLLBACK on throw, always releases client. Types exported: IsolationLevel, TransactionOptions.
- Money (src/money/money.ts): `parseAmount(input: number|string): bigint` (rejects non-int/negative/unsafe-number/overflow>2^63-1 via `InvalidAmountError` — map to 400 INVALID_AMOUNT); `serializeAmount(b: bigint): string`; `canonicalJson(body: unknown): string` (design §11.1: parse-then-normalize, money keys {amount,fee,fee_paise,balance} -> canonical bigint string, keys sorted by code-unit, no whitespace, NFC strings); `sha256Hex(s: string): string` (lowercase 64-char hex). body_hash = sha256Hex(canonicalJson(body)). NOTE: MONEY_KEYS set currently = {amount,fee,fee_paise,balance}; extend if request bodies introduce other money-bearing field names.
- Migration runner (src/db/migrateRunner.ts): `runMigrations(pool: Pool, migrationsDir?=<repo>/migrations): Promise<{ applied: string[] }>`. Ensures schema_migrations(version TEXT PK, applied_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()); applies each migrations/*.sql (lexicographic) not yet recorded, one txn per file (BEGIN/SQL/INSERT version/COMMIT), aborts+throws on failure. Idempotent. Importable by server/worker startup. CLI: scripts/migrate.ts (builds pool from env, exits non-zero on failure).
- migrations/ exists (currently only .gitkeep); FEAT-002 adds 0001..0015 .sql and scripts/seed.ts.

IMPORTANT PATH NOTE for FEAT that adds server.ts/worker.ts/Dockerfile wiring: tsconfig has rootDir='.' and includes src/scripts/test, so tsc emits to dist/src/*.js, dist/scripts/*.js, dist/test/*.js (NOT dist/server.js). The package.json scripts and Dockerfile/compose currently reference `node dist/server.js` / `node dist/worker.js` per design §5. When src/server.ts & src/worker.ts land, reconcile this: either (a) set tsconfig rootDir='src' + separate build for scripts, or (b) update start:api/start:worker/Dockerfile/compose to `node dist/src/server.js` / `node dist/src/worker.js`. migrateRunner resolves migrations via ../../migrations relative to its own compiled location, which stays correct under dist/src/db/.

Git: committed on branch main; NO remote (never push/add remote).
